proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type (directional-long) = Choppy regime 83.33% + UP_TRI/BULL_PROXY 100% directional-long (83.3%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type (directional-long) = Choppy regime 83.33% + UP_TRI/BULL_PROXY 100% directional-long; recommended action: Pause new entries in regime=Choppy AND pause new directional-long (UP_TRI/BULL_PROXY) adds until either (a) Choppy share drops below 0.80 via natural Day-6 exits, or (b) Choppy×UP_TRI cohort tier upgrades from Candidate to Tier M. Consider a small index-put or short-beta hedge sized to ~15-20% of book notional to offset the single-direction exposure.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If Choppy regime flips to Bear or a sharp gap-down occurs, all 12 positions correlate to the downside simultaneously — no offsetting shorts, no validated edge in the dominant cohort to justify riding through drawdown, and sector cluster in Bank+Pharma (8/12 = 67%) amplifies single-factor risk on a broad-market or rate-shock event.

evidence: Signal mix: UP_TRI 9/12 = 75% + BULL_PROXY 3/12 = 25% = 100% directional-long monoculture
UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell at 16.67% (2/12) — below 0.20 but concentrated
UP_TRI×Choppy×Pharma cell at 16.67% (2/12) — below 0.20 but concentrated
Both concentrated cells match only Choppy×UP_TRI cohort at Candidate tier (n=338) — unvalidated edge
Extends multi-week warn streak of directional-long exposure without cohort validation
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause new entries in regime=Choppy AND pause new directional-long (UP_TRI/BULL_PROXY) adds until either (a) Choppy share drops below 0.80 via natural Day-6 exits, or (b) Choppy×UP_TRI cohort tier upgrades from Candidate to Tier M. decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: If Choppy regime flips to Bear or a sharp gap-down occurs, all 12 positions correlate to the downside simultaneously — no offsetting shorts, no validated edge in the dominant cohort to justify riding through drawdown, and sector cluster in Bank+Pharma (8/12 = 67%) amplifies single-factor risk on a broad-market or rate-shock event.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration is triggered at 83.33% Choppy (10/12, above the 0.80 threshold), and the book is effectively a directional-long monoculture at 100% (UP_TRI 9/12 = 75% + BULL_PROXY 3/12 = 25%). Both concentrated cells (UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank at 16.67% and UP_TRI×Choppy×Pharma at 16.67%) match only the Candidate-tier Choppy×UP_TRI cohort (n=338) — unvalidated edge across all concentration axes. Extends a multi-week warn streak of regime + directional-long monoculture on an unvalidated cohort.
